# oneuptime_trace_scrub_rule (Resource)

Trace scrub rule resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_trace_scrub_rule" "example" {
  name = "John Doe"
  pattern_type = "Example short text"
  scrub_action = "Example short text"
  fields_to_scrub = "Example short text"
}
```
